result.summary: Wrote lit.md covering the 4 literature topics from analysis.md (targeting core 1 day_durbin_watson(Volume), core 2 ts_med(day_skew(Volume),30), and N-2's institutional dimensions). Used WebSearch + WebFetch, applying the 2023-08-08 cutoff (using working-paper dates where journal versions postdated it, e.g. Lof & van Bommel's 2018 BOF discussion paper instead of the 2023 JCF version). For each topic, distilled literature constructions into operator-language recipes (e.g. direct ts_corr-based ACF instead of DW-style energy ratios; within-stock ts_zscore vs cross-sectional normalization per MSCI's head-to-head study; ListAge-based thresholding for new listings per Bao Qi 2023 and Wan et al. 2015; asymmetric ceiling/floor conditioning per Wong-Liu-Zeng 2009). 15 distinct sources cited, all with title/authors/year-month/venue/link/verified flag (all 15 verified true via direct WebFetch or quoted search-result content); each topic also lists explicit "not found" items (e.g. no literature puts a DW-style statistic on volume directly; no Herfindahl-based intraday volume concentration factor found; no academic study of ST-stock volume anomalies pre-cutoff) rather than fabricating sources.
